title: Portfolio Analyst

why_us: Strategic Advisers manages over $1.4 trillion in model portfolios, and this role sits where the portfolio managers' views get checked against what the portfolios actually hold. That is the part of the work I like: reconciling results that don't match the stated strategy and finding out why. At AMG Family Dental I built a Python reconciliation that cut a weekly 5-hour process to 1 hour and flagged underpaid claims. I would bring the same habit to performance, positioning and attribution reporting, with a Brandeis finance and economics background behind it.
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Portfolio Analyst position on the Fundamental Model Management Team at Strategic Advisers in Boston. The role is about making sure model portfolios match the investment views behind them, and about catching and explaining any result that does not. That kind of checking is what I do best.

For the past three years I have been the Financial Manager at AMG Family Dental in Belmont, MA. I run budgeting, monthly forecasting, and budget-versus-actual variance analysis for ownership, and I identified and recovered more than $500K in annual revenue by tightening reporting and reconciliation. I also wrote a Python process that automated our weekly insurance payment reconciliation, cutting it from five hours to one and flagging underpaid claims for follow-up. When numbers disagree, I trace the cause rather than adjust around it, which is the same discipline needed to reconcile portfolio results against a manager's strategy.

Earlier, as a Financial Analyst Intern at Northrop Grumman, I audited more than 100 financial models for accuracy, compliance and internal controls, and I presented cost-saving recommendations on pricing, supplier costs and budget variances to senior leadership. That taught me to document my work so someone else can follow it and to explain findings clearly to people who make the decisions.

My academic training supports this work. I hold an M.A. in International Economics and Finance (STEM) from Brandeis, with coursework in Corporate Finance, Econometrics, Statistics and Advanced Finance, and a B.S. in Finance from Suffolk. I work in Excel, SQL, Python (Pandas, NumPy) and R, and my resume lists Bloomberg Terminal and Tableau.

I am a U.S. citizen, available immediately, and I would welcome the chance to talk about how I can support the team's reporting, analytics and trade-related work.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian
